description: This file defines extension methods for the IBufferWriter<byte> interface, enabling efficient writing of byte sequences, including support for multi-segment buffers, within the Orleans serialization framework.

classes.name: BufferWriterExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for IBufferWriter<byte> to facilitate writing byte sequences efficiently.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes a ReadOnlySequence<byte> to the buffer writer by iterating over its segments.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes a ReadOnlySpan<byte> to the buffer writer, attempting a fast path for contiguous memory or falling back to multi-segment writing.

methods.name: WriteMultiSegment
methods.description: Handles writing a ReadOnlySpan<byte> to the buffer writer across multiple segments when the fast path is not applicable.
